query:
INSERT INTO pulsify.issues
             (id, project_id, fingerprint, plugin, status, first_version, last_version,
              first_seen_at, last_seen_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'open', $5, $5, now(), now())
         ON CONFLICT (project_id, fingerprint) DO NOTHING
         RETURNING id
